DFFL Week 1 Game Preview

Mahomies Homie vs JetLiX

AFC WESTDallas • Mahomies Homie
108.7
VS
NFC NORTHJetLiX
116.4
Prediction: NFC North by 7.7

Matchup Outlook

This could be one of Week 1's highest-scoring matchups. The NFC North enters the season as the DFFL preseason #1 division, with elite fantasy firepower throughout Detroit, Green Bay, Minnesota and Chicago. Dallas has plenty of upside in the AFC West, but Mahomies Homie may need its biggest stars to hit their ceilings to keep pace.

3 Players to Watch

AFC WestPatrick Mahomes — KCBrock Bowers — LVLadd McConkey — LAC
NFC NorthJahmyr Gibbs — DETJustin Jefferson — MINAmon-Ra St. Brown — DET

2025 Division DNA

The NFC North went a combined 38-29-1, scored 1,657 points and allowed 1,521. The AFC West finished 34-34, scoring 1,372 and allowing 1,411. That gives the NFC North a substantial 285-point offensive advantage based on last season's combined NFL results.

DFFL Take

Dallas has enough star power to win this matchup, but JetLiX has the deeper collection of potential difference-makers. The 2025 numbers and the preseason DFFL model both lean toward the NFC North.

🏈 Draft Day Storyline

#7 DRAFTED AFC WEST vs #1 DRAFTED NFC NORTH

Dallas gets an immediate opportunity to prove the seventh division off the board was undervalued. JetLiX gets the opposite challenge: defend the division that went #1 overall in the inaugural DFFL division draft.

DFFL Week 1 Game Preview

Coast Killers Amigos vs Brian

NFC EASTJuan • Coast Killers Amigos
104.2
VS
AFC NORTHBrian
109.8
Prediction: AFC North by 5.6

Matchup Outlook

This feels like the Week 1 grinder. Both divisions have high-end individual fantasy stars, but neither has the same across-the-board depth as the preseason favorites. One or two monster performances could decide this matchup.

3 Players to Watch

NFC EastCeeDee Lamb — DALSaquon Barkley — PHIJalen Hurts — PHI
AFC NorthJa'Marr Chase — CINLamar Jackson — BALDerrick Henry — BAL

2025 Division DNA

The AFC North went 29-39 with 1,514 points scored, while the NFC East went 27-40-1 with 1,587 points scored. The NFC East produced more offense, but also surrendered 1,726 points compared with the AFC North's 1,656.

DFFL Take

Juan has several players capable of exploding in any given week. Brian's AFC North, however, offers a dangerous combination of elite quarterback, running back and wide receiver options. Slight edge to the AFC North.

🏈 Draft Day Storyline

#4 DRAFTED NFC EAST vs #3 DRAFTED AFC NORTH

These divisions were selected back-to-back. Brian took the AFC North third, and Juan followed with the NFC East fourth. Week 1 gives us an immediate head-to-head test of those draft-day decisions.

DFFL Week 1 Game Preview

The Fighting Josh Allen's vs Ben

AFC EASTJoshua • The Fighting Josh Allen's
110.1
VS
NFC WESTBen
113.6
Prediction: NFC West by 3.5

Matchup Outlook

This is the Week 1 matchup to watch. The AFC East has Josh Allen plus an increasingly dangerous group of fantasy options, while the NFC West brings some of the league's most productive skill players and gives Ben several different ways to construct a high-ceiling lineup.

3 Players to Watch

AFC EastJosh Allen — BUFJames Cook — BUFBreece Hall — NYJ
NFC WestPuka Nacua — LARChristian McCaffrey — SFJaxon Smith-Njigba — SEA

2025 Division DNA

The AFC East finished 36-32 with 1,618 points scored, but the NFC West was spectacular at 41-27 with 1,793 points scored and only 1,497 allowed. The NFC West was the strongest combined NFL division of this matchup based on last season's results.

DFFL Take

Josh Allen can single-handedly swing a fantasy matchup, but Ben's NFC West has an exceptional menu of skill-position talent. This one looks close enough that a single late-game touchdown could flip the result.

🏈 Draft Day Storyline

#5 DRAFTED AFC EAST vs #2 DRAFTED NFC WEST

Ben grabbed the NFC West second after its four teams combined for 41 NFL victories and 1,793 points in 2025. Joshua waited until fifth and built his division around the AFC East. Week 1 asks whether the gap between pick #2 and pick #5 was justified.

DFFL Week 1 Game Preview

KVR1 vs Bandwagon Elites

AFC SOUTHKendall • KVR1
103.8
VS
NFC SOUTHXavier • Bandwagon Elites
115.9
Prediction: NFC South by 12.1

Matchup Outlook

This is the largest projected spread of Week 1. The AFC South has several major individual weapons, but the NFC South enters the preseason DFFL model near the top of the league and offers multiple ways to build a high-upside lineup.

3 Players to Watch

AFC SouthJonathan Taylor — INDBrian Thomas Jr. — JAXNico Collins — HOU
NFC SouthBijan Robinson — ATLDrake London — ATLMike Evans — TB

2025 Division DNA

The AFC South had the stronger combined 2025 NFL season at 36-32 with 1,628 points scored and 1,521 allowed. The NFC South went 30-38 with 1,350 points scored and 1,575 allowed. On pure NFL results, Kendall's division enters with the stronger résumé.

DFFL Take

This may be Week 1's best test of NFL strength versus fantasy strength. Kendall owns the division with the better 2025 NFL résumé, while Xavier owns the division the DFFL preseason model believes is much better suited to this fantasy format.

🏈 Draft Day Storyline

#8 DRAFTED AFC SOUTH vs #6 DRAFTED NFC SOUTH

Two of the final three divisions selected meet immediately. Kendall has a perfect “you guys got this wrong” opportunity: the AFC South was drafted last despite winning six more combined NFL games and scoring 278 more points than the NFC South in 2025.
